How to Play

Hit Start and hold your best face for the whole round — your camera does all the work. No buttons, no controllers. Just your face.

👁️
Eyes Open — keep both eyes wide open.
😊
Smile — give your biggest, happiest smile.
🤨
Brows Raised — raise your eyebrows as high as they'll go.
🎭
Expression Lock — press Lock Expression to save the face you're making, then keep holding that expression.
📐
Head Still — stay as still as possible and don't move your head around.
⚡
Combo Bonus — nail all five at the same time for extra points!

How scoring works: Every second you hold an expression, you earn a point for it. Hold more expressions at once to rack up points faster. The cards on the right light up when you're scoring, and a little bar fills up as your time grows.

Palm pause — hold an open hand up to the camera to pause scoring. Put it down to keep going. The camera border turns orange when paused.

⚙️ Technical Details
Criterion Detection threshold
👁️ Eyes OpenEye Aspect Ratio (EAR) > 0.2 (both eyes)
😊 SmileHappy expression confidence > 38%, or dominant emotion is happy
🤨 Brows RaisedBrow peak ≥ 1.5× eye-height above top eyelid (both brows)
🎭 Expression LockLocked emotion must remain dominant at > 28% confidence
📐 Head StillNose-tip displacement < 14 px over a 600 ms rolling window
⚡ ComboAll five criteria active simultaneously; tracked as a separate counter

Score formula: each criterion accumulates active seconds independently. Final score = sum of active seconds across all five criteria. Maximum possible = duration (s) × 5 (e.g. 180 × 5 = 900 pts for a 3-minute round). Combo seconds are counted on top of individual criteria.
